notes:
# Clear sound when you listen from your phone {waveform}
Listening or watching live used to crackle and cut out, even in a silent
meeting. The sound now comes through clean and steady.

# Talk in the meeting's chat from your phone {text.bubble}
Type a message on your phone and it appears in the meeting's chat, in
your name. The Mac asks you first before any phone is allowed to.

# A recording stays in one piece {record.circle}
A quiet meeting was mistaken for Zoom going blank, so the recording
switched to your whole screen and back, splitting the file. It now stays
on the meeting.

---

Everything else in this release:

- Watching live works on mobile data, not only on Wi-Fi.
- The live picture keeps the meeting window's shape, with no black band.
- The recording time shown on the Mac and your phone no longer jumps back
  to zero partway through.
- A recording you start from anywhere opens in the app straight away.
- When you stop a recording from your phone, the alert says so.
- Your phone says what needs fixing on the Mac, not just which check.
